description: This file defines a set of React components for a dropdown menu UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons. It includes components for menu items, groups, labels, separators, submenus, and trigger elements, with styling and behavior encapsulated within each component.

methods.name: DropdownMenu
methods.description: Main dropdown menu component wrapping Radix UI Root primitive.

methods.name: DropdownMenuPortal
methods.description: Component rendering dropdown content within a portal.

methods.name: DropdownMenuTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the dropdown menu.

methods.name: DropdownMenuContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown menu content with styling and animation.

methods.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: Checkbox item within the dropdown menu.

methods.name: DropdownMenuRadioGroup
methods.description: Radio group for mutually exclusive options.

methods.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
methods.description: Radio button item within the dropdown menu.
